In [11]:
def pca(data, n_components):
    if n_components >= data.shape[1]:
        raise ValueError(f"PCA components ({n_components}) must "
                         f"be less than the dimension of the data ({data.shape[1]})")
    sigma = np.cov(data.T)
    eigenvals, eigenvecs =  np.linalg.eig(sigma)
    transform = eigenvecs[:, :n_components]
    return data.dot(transform)
